components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one orange action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: var(--accent-fill, #f6821f); color: var(--on-accent, #1a0d02); font: 500 0.8125rem/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12); transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent-fill, #f6821f) 90%, #000); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #f6821f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e3e3); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: var(--surface-raised, #fff); color: var(--text-primary, #171717); font: 500 0.8125rem/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04); transition: all 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #cfcfcf); background: var(--surface-hover, #ececec); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #f6821f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Low-weight actions in toolbars and headers.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #525252); font: 500 0.8125rem/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: all 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #ececec); color: var(--text-primary, #171717); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #f6821f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, 36px field, orange border and peach halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary, #525252); } .ds-input { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e3e3); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: var(--surface-raised, #fff); color: var(--text-primary, #171717); font: inherit; font-size: 0.8125rem; outline: none; caret-color: var(--accent-fill, #f6821f); transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #6b6b6b); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #cfcfcf); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent-fill, #f6821f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, #fff1e6); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Small worded status; live adds the pinging dot.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 20px; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--accent-line, #fbc49a); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); background: var(--accent-soft, #fff1e6); color: var(--accent, #c2410c); font: 500 0.6875rem/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pill-neutral { border-color: var(--line, #e3e3e3); background: var(--surface-raised, #fff); color: var(--text-secondary, #525252); } .ds-live-dot { position: relative; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--live, #e5600b); } .ds-live-dot::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; background: inherit; animation: ds-ping 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-ping { from { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.6; } to { transform: scale(3); opacity: 0; } }

components.name: Ledger
components.description: Rows inside one bordered raised container, hairline between rows.
components.html:
• Riverside XI v Hill CC142/6
  • Northend v Parkside98/3
  • Old Boys v DockyardSat 10:30
components.css: .ds-ledger { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e3e3); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 8px); background: var(--surface-raised, #fff); overflow: hidden; font: 400 0.8125rem/1.4 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text-primary, #171717); } .ds-ledger-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e3e3); transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-ledger-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-ledger-row:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #ececec); } .ds-tabular { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Stat Strip
components.description: A dl split into cells by left border dividers.
components.css: .ds-stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e3e3); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 8px); background: var(--surface-raised, #fff); overflow: hidden; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stats > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-stats > div + div { border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e3e3); } .ds-stats dt { font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted, #6b6b6b); } .ds-stats dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text-primary, #171717); }

narrative.overview:
Howzat reads like an infrastructure dashboard that happens to keep score. Neutral grays carry no tint, panels are bordered rather than lifted, and one orange accent marks the action, the live state, and the boundary. Density is high and calm: small type, short controls, and rows that pack many matches into one screen without crowding.

Light is the default theme. Dark sits behind a toggle that sets `data-theme="dark"` on the root and persists the choice. Both themes share one layout and one set of token names, so a component never branches on theme. The scoreboard is the exception that proves the rule: it stays a dark board in both themes, because a score display reads as an instrument rather than a page.

Copy is minimal and sentence case. Headings name the thing; they do not sell it. The old green-tinted dark matchday look is retired.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral grays with zero hue, light first, dark on request.
A single orange accent with separate text and fill values.
Geist for everything, tabular numerals for every figure.
Compact controls (32 to 40px) and 13px working text.
Flat bordered panels, with shadow reserved for the primary button inset and floating layers.
A drafting-table motif (faint grid, corner ticks) used sparingly on hero and sign-in plates.

rules.name: The No Tint Rule
rules.body: Grays are true neutrals. A gray with a green, blue, or warm cast does not belong in this system.

rules.name: The Two Oranges Rule
rules.body: Fill orange is for surfaces and strokes; text orange is for type. Never set body text in the fill value on a light surface.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Orange is the only accent. Team identity colors appear only inside team marks.

rules.name: The Small Label Rule
rules.body: The uppercase label marks a datum (a `dt`, a column head, a board stat). It never sits above a heading as a kicker and never introduces a section.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change (runs, overs, standings, counts) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Border First Rule
rules.body: Separate with a hairline before reaching for a shadow. A resting card has no shadow.

dos: Do use true neutral grays and the single orange accent.
Do put text orange on type and fill orange on surfaces, with on-accent ink over fill.
Do keep page h1 at the headline size and section h2 at the title size.
Do group lists as ledger rows inside one bordered raised container.
Do show stats as a `dl` strip with left border dividers.
Do set every changing number in tabular figures.
Do write minimal, sentence case copy.
Do design in light first and let dark follow through the same tokens.
donts: Don't tint the grays green, blue, or warm.
Don't use the uppercase label as a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't add shadows to resting cards.
Don't set white text on the orange fill.
Don't introduce a second accent hue outside status colors and team marks.
Don't signal status with color alone.
